_authoring_rule: Queries are written from memory of the TOPIC, never from the document. Each memory gets three held-out queries: a question a user would type, a paraphrase in different vocabulary, and a half-remembered fragment. A query must not share any run of four consecutive words with the title or content of a memory it expects; fixture::tests::held_out_queries_share_no_4gram_with_their_target enforces this (words are lowercased and split on every non-alphanumeric character). When a mode scores everything, make the queries harder. Never make the metric looser.
_comment: Synthetic recall/judge fixture. Seeds a fresh store; independent of the live repo. Keep expected_ids referencing existing memory ids.
